findings.observation: The entire dagger is uncropped, but the pommel reaches to roughly 7% from the top edge, inside the prohibited 8% safe-margin zone.
Exactly one complete dagger is present, with blade, guard, grip, and pommel and no sheath, second weapon, or loose component.
The short double-edged thrusting blade, compact guard, and single-hand grip read immediately as a fighting dagger.
The blade has a coherent reinforced central section, the guard seats cleanly at the shoulder, and the wrapped one-hand grip terminates in a weighted pommel consistent with full-tang construction.
Starmetal dominates the blade and supplies the only exceptional rank cue, while the dark grip wrap and restrained fittings remain subordinate.
Fine particulate metallic inclusions within the blade and its layered reinforced fullers establish a meteoric starmetal character beyond blue palette alone.
Blue emission is confined to the narrow central fuller and sparse inclusions; the edges, hilt, and grip do not glow, so behavior remains locally bounded.
The output uses a premium realistic painterly finish, honest wear, cold key light, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal background, and grounded floor plane consistent with the accepted profile.

The pommel bears a prominent embossed star emblem that reads as an ornament or logo-like mark used to reinforce material identity, violating the no-ornament-as-material-identity and no-logos constraints; the remaining declared negatives pass.
